text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes~
I wonder who I should bet on.
The lineup is so stacked, I can't decide~!!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
I get it, I get it! Hold on a sec,
let me look over the list again—wait, what?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, another runner just signed up?!
At this timing?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: No..., ...Rhein Kraft did.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft is...'unconscious'—?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Here... it's just me?
Is no one else here...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
B-But... why?
I mean—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "B-Because! Cesario... and Messiah-san, and Heart-san too...!"

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Everyone else's came true.
Mine was the only one that didn't.

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one... whose journey ends here.

As gentle autumn sunlight filtered through the window,
Rhein Kraft slept peacefully on.

"Racing entries. Academy life.
Her time had come to a complete standstill.
Returning to racing or school seemed unthinkable right now."
And—

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
please come to the examination room."

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text: Craft-san's parents are here.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: ――Very well. So we are transferring you to the local hospital tomorrow, is that correct?

text_block_list.name: Craft's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I look forward to working with you.
...Trainer, thank you so much
for staying by my side all this time.

text_block_list.name: Craft's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You've become so worn out...
I'm truly, deeply sorry.
choice_data_list: N-No, not at all... I'm really nothing special...

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
"We'll stay right by your side and watch over you this time.
All the way until you wake up.
...Even if you never do."

text_block_list.name: Craft's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Thank you so, so much...
for everything you've done for my daughter.

I see off Rhein Kraft's parents as they leave, bowing repeatedly.
The two of them had come to pick her up, caring for their daughter from the bottom of their hearts.

"Come tomorrow, Rhein Kraft will be taken back home by them.
...I won't be able to stay by her side anymore."
choice_data_list: (Is there... anything more I can do—)
(Is there... anything more I can do—)

text_block_list.text:
Is it just "praying"? Just "wishing"?
Praying that a miracle might happen someday,
that good fortune might come someday?

I cover my eyes with both hands.
I clench my back teeth until they creak.
Praying, wishing, simply waiting for miracles and good fortune—
Had she ever done that, even once?

No matter what hardships, what walls she ran into,
she—Rhein Kraft—
always broke through with her own hands, with her own two legs.
Miracles. Good fortune. Beyond the dream—
choice_data_list: You were reaching out to grab it, weren't you...!

text_block_list.text:
"I shake my head twice vigorously. Then,
I roughly wipe away the pathetic tears welling in my eyes
and start running."

My mind was made up. All that was left was to struggle on.
...The time limit was one more day.
Fired up with enthusiasm, the place I headed to was—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...And so you ran all the way to us,
out of breath like that?"
choice_data_list: I wanted... Craft to call out to me...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see. ...However, Trainer, I believe it would be best for you to rehydrate first.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...There's no need to rush.
We've been ready to head out
for a long time now.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course! I was actually just about to head there myself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Still, since we have the chance.
Would you do me the honor of escorting me?
Craft's Trainer.
Wait right theeeere—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yo. Sorry for spooking ya.
This kid was just dying to—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...No. It's just that all of us, myself included,
couldn't help but feel that way."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Don't just "Huh" me, you dummy!
Seriously, what were you thinking,
trying to leave us behind?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's your job, so take them already!
...We're all gonna wake that sleepyhead right up!

"With everyone." Startled by Sweep Tosho's words,
I glance around at our surroundings.
And there, standing before us, was—

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: ...This is the end of the line for 'me.'

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't pass anything on.
I couldn't leave anything behind.

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text: "My" dream did not come true.

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text:
"That's why 'I' am here alone.
There's nobody else. Just me, all alone."

text_block_list.name: "Me"
text_block_list.text:
That is "me."
...And that is you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Couldn't I connect anything? Couldn't I leave anything behind?
...Nothing at all?)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: My hands... are warm, you know.
—And so, she...

Daring Heart took Rhein Kraft's hand
as she slept on, gently wrapping
her fingers around it and holding it close.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...We held hands like this
after the NHK Mile Cup, too.
We shook hands, right? Do you remember?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I remember. Because it's etched into my heart.
...Carrying the passion that burned within me back then, I've run all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And yet, look at you—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Dummy! How long do you plan to sleep?
I despise lazy girls!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"What are you doing, honestly.
You are—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even though I—the future Queen—admired that Umamusume!

And then Air Messiah and Cesario too.
One by one, Line Craft's precious rivals
stepped forward to take and hold her hand.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The sun" shouldn't sleep forever, Craft-san.
Otherwise, the dawn will never arrive, will it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...After the Shuka Sho, I went to see my mother
and made a vow to her."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"One day, for sure. I will compete against the Umamusume
who illuminated my path and inspired me... and I will win."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to my mother, I will not budge.
So please wake up, Craft-san.
If you don't, I won't forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Please wake up.
Let us compete together once more."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Craft... I was right by your side,
yet I didn't even notice. I'm sorry. I—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wake up, Craft. If you don't... I will go on ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Did you think I would be plagued by injury forever? Too bad for you.
...I've already got my comeback race all figured out!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So... get up. Open your eyes.
...Start running, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you going to show us your back?
...That back of yours, which made us gaze in awe
and yearn to follow you.

Everyone there—
Every single Tiara Umamusume—
Joined hands with Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Sleepyheads can't become great witches, you know?
Wake up, Craft!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who lit a fire under us in the first place. Take responsibility all the way to the end!
...I'm countin' on you, Craft."

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Craft.
...Craft!

text_block_list.name: Tiara Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "—Craft!!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...No. That's not true.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's not true that you left nothing behind.
It's not true that you failed to pass the torch!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because! Heart-san, Cesario, and Messiah-san—
everyone looked up to me!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even the senior Tiara Umamusume I looked up to!
They looked at my back and started running too...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I am leaving my mark. My legacy is living on!
Inside everyone who ever watched my back!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too.
...Because "you" ran with everything you had, too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"That's why someone looked up to me.
Someone kept me in their heart."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...You're not alone.
This isn't where it ends."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The yearning left behind, the connected feelings,
they will carry us forward.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: So... right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Let's go, together!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Togeth... er...

...Slowly at first.
But then rapidly, it arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ah... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, I... remember today's.
It was kind of strange... a bit sad,
yet warm dream—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, huh!? Trainer!?
A-Are you crying!? Why!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear.
Why not let them cry, just for today?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, waaaah?!
Everyone... even the s-seniors are here?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, um, ah, what...!
U-Um, err...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: G-Good moooorning!!

Rhein Kraft called out at the top of her lungs.
The room was filled with the warm laughter of the gathered Tiara Umamusume.
"The reason so many girls have gathered here is solely because of the bonds Rhein Kraft forged through her running."
A miracle she pulled toward herself with her own hands... through her love for the Tiara and her hopes for the future.

And so, laughing together with everyone...
we celebrated Rhein Kraft's comeback.
